overheadVsPlainX402.boundaryNote: Both spans end in a local-facilitator settlement. The CLB-ACEL span additionally performs commitment recomputation, CLB signature verification, the predicate guard decision, evidence chain/Merkle construction and full verifyTrace (which internally re-verifies the x402 authorization). Components use the prebuilt M15/M16/M17/M19/M20 fixtures; the summed span is a cost model, not one coherent end-to-end trace.

labeling.gas: LOCAL ANVIL / DEMO — NOT MAINNET AND NOT A PUBLIC TESTNET

gas.reason: Foundry available; real transactions executed on a local Anvil EVM.

computeCommitment.boundary: computeCommitment(clbInput) — Mode A C = keccak256(EIP712(identityRef, mandateDigest, settlementDigest)); input prepared outside timer.

computeModeBSettlementCommitment.boundary: computeModeBSettlementCommitment(input) — Mode B C' = keccak256(EIP712(identityRef, mandateDigest, predicateId, settlementParamsDigest)).

verifyPaymentPayload.boundary: await verifyPaymentPayload(payload) — EIP-712 recovery + expected-signer equality for the x402 authorization.

verifyCommitmentSignature.boundary: await verifyCommitmentSignature(clbInput, signature, expectedSigner) — CLB EIP-712 signature recovery.

guardAssertSettlementAllowed.boundary: await InMemoryPredicateGuard.assertSettlementAllowed(guardInput) — predicate eval + C' recompute + expectedNonce binding + allow/deny decision.

evaluatePredicate.boundary: evaluatePredicate(predicate, params, now, observedTaskHash) — pure rule evaluation only.

guardEvaluateOffChain.boundary: guard.evaluateOffChain(predicate, params, now, observedTaskHash) — adapter entry point, same pure evaluator.

evidenceChainGeneration.boundary: linkEvidenceEvents(events) + events.map(hashEvidenceEvent) + buildMerkleRoot(hashes) — hash-chained evidence plus Merkle root; input events prepared outside timer.

confidentialRangeProofEvidence.boundary: commitConfidential({valueAtomic, maxValueAtomic, payTo}, {rng}) — Pedersen commitment + 64-bit per-bit range proof evidence (deterministic RNG).

verifyTrace.boundary: await verifyTrace(validModeABundle) — all deterministic rules R1–R17 and certificate hash; bundle prebuilt outside timer.

e2eModeATransaction.boundary: buildValidBundle({traceId}) + verifyTrace(bundle) — full Mode A: mandate issue, C/nonce, x402 signing, local facilitator settle, evidence chain, report/delivery signatures, verification.

M26.title: Overhead of the full CLB-ACEL path vs plain x402

plainX402Accept.boundary: await verifyPaymentPayload(payload) + await facilitator.settle(payload) on a fresh local facilitator — plain x402 authorization + settlement. Payload and fresh facilitator prepared outside timer.

clbAcelAcceptAndVerify.boundary: computeCommitment + verifyCommitmentSignature + guard.assertSettlementAllowed + (link/hash/Merkle over 7 events) + verifyTrace(bundle) + facilitator.settle(payload) — full CLB-ACEL acceptance/verification pipeline. All inputs, including a fresh facilitator, prepared outside timer.
